name: Web Development
overview: The Web Development course is designed for learners who want to build dynamic, responsive, and interactive websites using modern web technologies.
description: The course provides practical training in website development and helps learners understand how to design, develop, and deploy functional web applications. It is suitable for beginners, students, freelancers, and aspiring web developers.
eligibility: Open to anyone interested in learning web development.
prerequisites: Basic computer knowledge is recommended but not mandatory.

duration.note: Course duration varies. Please contact the academy for details.

fees.note: Please contact the academy for the latest fee details.

teaching_methodology: Personalized teaching with practical coding sessions, live website development, and individual attention.
study_material: Comprehensive study material is provided according to the course requirements.
faculty: Highly qualified, experienced, patient, and supportive faculty members.
learning_outcomes: Understand the web application development process
Improve logical thinking and problem-solving abilities
Build a strong foundation for a career in web development

faqs.question: Who can join the Web Development course?
faqs.answer: Students, beginners, job seekers, working professionals, freelancers, and anyone interested in website development can join.

faqs.question: Do I need programming knowledge before joining?
faqs.answer: No official prerequisite has been specified. Basic computer knowledge is recommended.

faqs.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course is suitable for beginners who want to start learning web development.

faqs.question: Is practical training included?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course emphasizes practical coding and hands-on website development.

faqs.question: Will I work on projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. Practical website development is an important part of the learning process.

faqs.question: Do you provide study material?
faqs.answer: Yes. Comprehensive study material is provided according to the course requirements.

faqs.question: How can I know the course duration and fees?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy for the latest duration and fee details.
